metric_definitions.top1_top5_top10: Hit rate: fraction of non-diagnostic queries with at least one positive image at or above rank k.
metric_definitions.mrr: Mean reciprocal rank of the first positive image; zero if no positive is present in the full ranking.
metric_definitions.hard_negative_margin: Best positive cosine minus best hard-negative cosine; positive is better. Empty hard-negative sets are excluded from that class's aggregate.
metric_definitions.diagnostic_only: Zero-positive queries are ranked and reported but excluded from Top-k, MRR and hard-negative aggregates.

queries.annotation_basis: Visual review of sink tags on every selected frame; includes dry toy sinks and a real sink adjacent to burners.
Visual review of pot/pan tags, including silver pots, pans and strainers; no action is implied.
Visual review of spoon/fork/knife/spatula tags; brush alone is not counted as these utensils.
Visual review of sponge/brush tags; includes sponge wiping, placement and burner scenes without asserting washing.
